wall_straight.diagnosis: Rejected model lacks parapet, buttresses, and arrow loops; lacks geological realism and heraldic detail.
wall_straight.design_intent: V3 limestone wall with bonded courses, parapet, tapered buttresses, and arrow loops for authentic medieval siege architecture.
wall_straight.material_intent: V3 limestone with blue/gold heraldry, natural earth tones, angular geology for historical authenticity and visual weight.
wall_straight.composition_notes: 8m wall with 26 courses, 2 arrow loops, 5 talus clusters, 0.45m buttresses, 0.65m road slab, 0.65° lean.

watchtower.diagnosis: V3 tower lacks structural integrity, machicolations, and coherent heraldry. Reconstruct with precise proportions.
watchtower.design_intent: Restore V3 tower with authentic limestone, blue/gold heraldry, and natural geology.
watchtower.material_intent: V3 limestone, blue/gold heraldry, natural earth and grey angular geology, consistent with Valoria 9.5/10 reference.
watchtower.composition_notes: Symmetrical, grounded, with crenels and machicolations, 1:1 scale with target.

wall_corner.diagnosis: Rejected design lacks continuous walkway, overlapping ends, and proper stone bonding around corner.
wall_corner.design_intent: Reconstructed arms with bonded stones, continuous path, and consistent V3 limestone geometry.
wall_corner.material_intent: V3 limestone, blue/gold heraldry, natural earth and grey angular geology, consistent with Valoria 9.5/10 standard.
wall_corner.composition_notes: True 90-degree arms, continuous walkway, no overlapping ends, stone crown and size match target.

wall_connections.diagnosis: Rejected model lacks dressed masonry and tapered pier; geometry inconsistent with V3 limestone standards.
wall_connections.design_intent: V3 stone wall: dressed ashlar blocks, tapering pier, heraldry flags, natural geology texture, earthy color palette.
wall_connections.material_intent: V3 limestone: grey angular blocks, blue/gold heraldry flags; natural earth tones and geologic texture dominance.
wall_connections.composition_notes: Symmetrical wall socket with tapered pier, consistent stone height/length, minimal loop count for structural clarity.

stone_path_platform.diagnosis: Rejected design lacks coherent stone geometry and fails to meet V3 limestone standard with no visible heraldry or earth support.
stone_path_platform.design_intent: V3 canonical masonry: varied flagstones, buried soil base, blue/gold banners, natural geology under strict engineering limits.
stone_path_platform.material_intent: V3 limestone, blue/gold heraldry on flagstones; natural earth and grey angular geology under z=0 with <0.025m relief.
stone_path_platform.composition_notes: Continuous road: varied slab lengths, buttress projection for stability, talus clusters as erosion markers.

cliff_rocks.diagnosis: Rejects round mesa; demands angular fault planes and talus clusters for escarpment realism.
cliff_rocks.design_intent: V3 limestone with heraldry: blue/gold banners, earthy grey geology, modular construction.
cliff_rocks.material_intent: V3 limestone: blue/gold heraldry, natural earth and grey angular geology.
cliff_rocks.composition_notes: 12m linear escarpment; crown z=0, exposed face 3.5m, closed base.

defensive_props.diagnosis: V3 banner requires modular attachment with real physical fastenings and brazier geometry.
defensive_props.design_intent: Blueprint: blue/gold heraldry on V3 limestone; natural earth geology, angular stone blocks.
defensive_props.material_intent: V3 limestone, blue/gold heraldry; natural earth and grey angular geology.
defensive_props.composition_notes: Brazier bowl on pedestal with cap/flames visible; wooden braces/iron fastenings.
